correctness.rationale: For every admissible prime power, cyclicity decomposes the power subgroup into four cosets of its cubic subfield intersection. A generator has a Frobenius ratio of order four, so its trace squared equals twice its norm; the norm is a cube. The three non-base cosets project as two coincident cubic cosets and a third coset whose equality is determined exactly by the cubic character of two. Exact fiber counting proves the complete representation law and cardinality formula for all prime powers. The packaged independent exact finite checker verifies the full claims for the seven listed prime base fields; the theorem does not rely on finite extrapolation.
